# What does a row take under the pointer, and what marks the selected tab?

Read this when your own markup shows a state, such as a row under the pointer or the tab a reader has selected.

**This page holds two roles and nothing else.** `--fill-hover` covers a cell as well as a row. A selected row, a focus ring and a disabled control have no role here.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Your markup and Arena's components both read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.

| role | question | utility | combines with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--edge-tab-selected` | What colour is the rule that marks the selected tab? | `border-edge-tab-selected` | none |
| `--fill-hover` | What colour does a table row, link card or navigation row take under the pointer? | `bg-hover` | none |
